description: Source file defining the `SecretsAsConfigSupplier` class, which loads secret values from file system paths specified in configuration or environment variables, and provides them as a combined Config object.

classes.name: SecretsAsConfigSupplier
classes.description: Immutable class that supplies a configuration object built from secrets stored in the file system, determined via environment variable or default path.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of SecretsAsConfigSupplier based on initial configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the combined Config object containing secrets.

methods.name: tryToGetSecretsFromFileSystemAsConfigObject
methods.description: Reads secrets from the file system, constructs a Config object containing these secrets, and includes them under the `secrets` key.

methods.name: getSecretValueFromFileSystem
methods.description: Retrieves a secret value object from the file system given a secret name.

methods.name: getSecretsDirPath
methods.description: Returns the Path object representing the secrets directory used by this supplier.
